mapper.sql: hold_id, lot_no, reason_code, hold_comment, held_at, held_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_hold (lot_no, reason_code, hold_comment, held_at, held_by) VALUES (#{lotNo}, #{reason}, #{comment}, #{heldAt}, #{heldBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM stock_hold WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lot_no = #{lotNo} AND released_at IS NULL ORDER BY held_at, hold_id
